message: Native SQL (EXEC SQL) is not Clean-Core; use CDS / Open SQL
OS command execution (CALL 'SYSTEM') is forbidden in Clean-Core
CLIENT SPECIFIED bypasses automatic client handling; review cross-client access
Dynamic WHERE condition (parenthesized variable); verify input is not attacker-controlled (SQL injection surface)
WRITE requires the classic list processor — forbidden in ABAP Cloud; use RAP/Fiori for output (CLOUD-006).
CALL FUNCTION is forbidden in generated ABAP Cloud code — use a released API method call (CLOUD-001).
TABLES parameters are a compile error in ABAP Cloud — use IMPORTING/EXPORTING/CHANGING TYPE TABLE OF (CLOUD-002).
MESSAGE ... TYPE relies on the classic message handler — use CX_* exception classes in ABAP Cloud (CLOUD-004).
FIELD-SYMBOLS typed as ANY defeats type safety — use a concrete type (CLOUD-007).
DESCRIBE TABLE ... LINES is forbidden in ABAP Cloud — use lines( itab ) (CLOUD-008).
GET REFERENCE OF is obsolete in ABAP Cloud — use REF #( ) (CLOUD-009).
READ REPORT bypasses the cloud boundary — use the XCO library for repository access (CLOUD-010).
BREAK-POINT is a debugging artefact — forbidden in shipped ABAP Cloud code (CLOUD-011).
USING CLIENT is forbidden in ABAP Cloud — the runtime sets the client implicitly (CLOUD-013).
Classic Dynpro statement (CALL/SET/LEAVE SCREEN, LEAVE PROGRAM) has no runtime in ABAP Cloud (CLOUD-014).
CL_SALV_TABLE=>factory is the classic ALV stack — not released in ABAP Cloud; use Fiori Elements (CLOUD-015).
Direct SY-UZEIT/DATUM/TIMLO/TZONE/ZONLO read lacks timezone context — use the XCO time library (CLOUD-016).
COMPUTE is the obsolete assignment prefix — drop it in ABAP Cloud (CLOUD-017).
DATA ... WITH HEADER LINE is a Dynpro-era construct forbidden in ABAP Cloud — declare a separate work area (CLOUD-018).
Reference to an SAP-internal-marked API (*_internal*) — no compatibility commitment; use a released API (CLOUD-031).
Direct SELECT from a SAP-namespace DDIC table — use the released CDS view (I_*) or BAPI (CLOUD-032).
ENHANCEMENT-POINT/ENHANCEMENT-SECTION is a source-code plug-in — only BAdI is clean-core compliant (CLOUD-019).
SAP modification marker $*$* — modifying SAP objects breaks on every upgrade (CLOUD-020).
PERFORM ... IN PROGRAM SAP* / RV* / RM* calls a SAP-internal subroutine — use a released class method or BAPI (CLOUD-022).
Implementation of an SAP-internal-flagged BAdI (IF_EX_*INTERNAL*) — not for customer extensions (CLOUD-026).
Classic user/customer exit (FORM userexit_* / FUNCTION customer_function_*) — migrate to a released BAdI (CLOUD-027).
SEGW / BOPF reference (/IWBEP/*_MGW_*, /BOBF/*) is superseded by RAP (CLOUD-030).
String-concatenation (&&) inside an EXEC SQL statement — SQL injection vector; use parameterized ABAP SQL (SEC-001).
OPEN DATASET with a non-literal (variable) path — path-traversal vector; validate the path (SEC-002).
Dynamic ABAP source generation via INSERT REPORT / GENERATE SUBROUTINE POOL — RCE risk (SEC-003).
CALL TRANSACTION with a variable t-code — bypasses static SU24/S_TCODE checks; validate against an allowlist (SEC-004).
Hardcoded credential in source (password/api_key/secret/token/bearer) — move to a Secure Store (SEC-005).
cl_abap_browser=>show_html with string concatenation — possible XSS; HTML-encode the input (SEC-006).
Direct kernel call CALL 'SYSTEM' / CALL 'C_*' bypasses the ABAP runtime + authority concept (SEC-007).
CALL FUNCTION ... DESTINATION with a variable destination — RFC routing controlled by data (SEC-009).
Location-header redirect set from a non-literal value — open-redirect risk; validate against an allowlist (SEC-010).
Direct SELECT from classic table T001/T005/MARA — use a CDS view entity (S4-001).
Classic list output (WRITE:/FORMAT COLOR) — migrate to ALV Grid or Fiori List Report (S4-003).
Screen-flow statement (SET SCREEN / CALL SCREEN) — migrate to Fiori Elements (S4-004).
Web Dynpro reference (IF_WD_* / WD_*) — WDYN sunset in S/4HANA 2027; migrate to Fiori (S4-005).
Direct FROM T001/T005/T006 config-table access — use CDS view I_CompanyCode / I_UoM (S4-006).
Field declared TYPE c LENGTH 18 — likely MATNR; truncates under S/4HANA's 40-char MATNR (S4-007).
Access to VBUK — header status table removed in S/4HANA; use VBAK / I_SalesDocument (S4-008).
Access to VBUP — item status table removed in S/4HANA; use VBAP / I_SalesDocumentItem (S4-009).
Access to KONV — pricing conditions replaced by PRCD_ELEMENTS in S/4HANA (S4-011).
1-char VBTYP comparison — silently fails after S/4HANA migration to 4-char VBTYPL (S4-013).
Field declared TYPE p LENGTH 11 — too short for S/4HANA's extended amount fields; use DMBTR/WRBTR/WERTV13 (S4-014).
SELECT from a deprecated FI/SD table (BSIS/BSAS/BSID/BSAD/BSIK/BSAK/KONV/VBFA) removed or restructured in S/4HANA (HARDY-04).
READ TABLE ... TRANSPORTING NO FIELDS then work-area access reads stale data — use line_exists( ) (HARDY-08).
IMPORTING VALUE(param) copies the argument on every call — pass by reference when unmutated (ABAP-PERF-57).
WITH DEFAULT KEY leaves key composition implicit — use WITH EMPTY KEY or explicit keys (ABAP-PERF-63).
Standalone APPEND ... TO — INSERT INTO TABLE is table-type-agnostic (ABAP-PERF-64).
READ TABLE ... TRANSPORTING NO FIELDS for an existence check — line_exists( ) is more direct (ABAP-PERF-65).
LEFT OUTER JOIN without MANY TO ONE — HANA cannot prune the join when right-side fields are unprojected (ABAP-PERF-85).
EML IN LOCAL MODE bypasses authorization — outside test code it is a perf-via-security-bypass antipattern (ABAP-PERF-73 / RAP-SEC-001).
Obsolete statement (MOVE/COMPUTE/ADD/SUBTRACT/MULTIPLY/DIVIDE) blocked in clean-core strict mode >=1 — use operators (CC-001).
Switch-Framework business-function state probe (cl_sfw_bf_status_check / cl_fdt_environment) — fixed per release in ABAP Cloud, so the branch is dead-or-always-taken (CLOUD-033).
cl_abap_browser=>show_html with string concatenation (&&) — possible XSS; HTML-encode via cl_abap_xml_utility=>html_encode or render via Fiori.
Direct instantiation of a custom class (NEW/CREATE OBJECT of z*/y*//ns/) — consider a factory/DI pattern for testability.
Switch Framework state-probe cl_sfw_bf_status_check=>is_active( ) — forbidden in ABAP Cloud; BF state is fixed per release, so the gated path is dead-or-always-taken (CLOUD-033).
Switch Framework state-probe cl_fdt_environment=>is_business_function_active( ) — forbidden in ABAP Cloud; BF state is fixed per release (CLOUD-033).
Switch Framework bulk-probe RFC 'SFW_BF_GET_BFS' — forbidden in ABAP Cloud; BF state is fixed per release (CLOUD-033).
Raw Switch Framework table read on SFW_BF_USERS_NEW — forbidden in ABAP Cloud; BF state is fixed per release (CLOUD-033).
EML COMMIT/ROLLBACK ENTITIES inside a RAP handler/saver — the RAP framework owns the LUW; remove it (ABAP-PERF-74).
COMMIT/ROLLBACK WORK inside a RAP handler/saver short-circuits the controlled SAP LUW — remove the manual commit (ABAP-PERF-75).
SUBMIT ... AND RETURN inside a RAP handler/saver bypasses the RAP transactional buffer — call an API/class instead (ABAP-PERF-76).
SAP GUI/screen statement inside a RAP handler/saver — RAP runs without a Dynpro session; surface dialogs via the RAP message protocol (ABAP-PERF-77).
EML MODIFY ENTITIES inside a FOR READ handler — read paths must not change buffer state; model side effects as an action/determination (ABAP-PERF-78).
CALL FUNCTION ... IN UPDATE TASK inside the ADJUST_NUMBERS/SAVE phase queues work past the LUW boundary — write inline in SAVE (ABAP-PERF-79).
CALL FUNCTION ... IN BACKGROUND UNIT inside the ADJUST_NUMBERS/SAVE phase binds bgRFC to the wrong LUW — schedule via bgPF after commit (ABAP-PERF-80).
LEFT OUTER JOIN without a MANY TO ONE qualifier — HANA cannot prune the join when right-side fields are unprojected; add MANY TO ONE for 1:1 cardinality (ABAP-PERF-85).
Literal constant in a JOIN ON clause triggers an engine switch + materialisation in HANA — move the constant filter to WHERE, keep ON column-to-column (ABAP-PERF-89).
Non-equi JOIN (BETWEEN/LIKE/<,>,<=,>=) forces an engine switch + materialisation with super-linear cardinality cost — restructure to an equi-join (ABAP-PERF-91).
CASE...ELSE constant is not NULL-preserving — prevents the optimiser from swapping CASE with a LEFT OUTER JOIN; omit ELSE or move CASE to the consumption view (ABAP-PERF-88).
SUM/AVG/MIN/MAX wrapping ROUND/CONVERT_CURRENCY/CAST/COALESCE runs the function per-row before aggregation — apply the function once on the aggregate result (ABAP-PERF-94).
Char-shaped column (_id/_key/_code/_nr/_text) compared to a bare numeric literal — possible implicit type-cast cost; use a typed host variable matching the DDIC type (ABAP-PERF-62).
Draft action declared without the 'optimized' addition — declare as 'draft action <name> optimized;' (ABAP-PERF-70).
EML MODIFY/READ ENTITIES ... IN LOCAL MODE bypasses authorization — outside a FOR TESTING class this is a perf-via-bypass anti-pattern; drop LOCAL MODE (ABAP-PERF-73).
SELECT * (incl. SELECT SINGLE *) fetches all columns; use an explicit field list or a projecting CDS view.
DDIC primitive cast in CDS (abap.char/numc/dec/int4/int8) loses semantic annotations; use a CDS-typed DataElement.
Currency/quantity @Semantics field likely missing @ObjectModel.foreignKey.association reference; add the master-entity association.
@AccessControl.authorizationCheck: #CHECK filters application-side; define DCL access control and use #PRIVILEGED_ONLY to push to SQL.
RAP behavior declares 'numbering :: early'; switch to 'numbering :: late' for create-heavy entities.
RAP deep-create (create( cba::child )) without a cardinality cap; cap child cardinality or split the deep-create into two roundtrips.
$expand-able association/composition [0..*] (or @ObjectModel.expand = true) without cardinality cap; restrict via maxItems or a paged sub-resource.
@ObjectModel.virtualElement runs per-row at fetch time and breaks server-side filtering; move to a CDS view function or association.
READ TABLE ... WITH KEY against a STANDARD internal table is O(n); declare the table HASHED or SORTED for keyed lookup (ABAP-PERF-06).
Bare LOOP AT (no WHERE / USING KEY) over a SORTED/HASHED table does a pure sequential scan; use TYPE STANDARD TABLE if only scanned sequentially (ABAP-PERF-07).
LOOP AT ... INTO ls_row copies each row by value; use ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs>) or REFERENCE INTO to skip the copy (ABAP-PERF-08).
COLLECT into a STANDARD table is O(n) per insert; declare the target HASHED TABLE with the COLLECT key as UNIQUE KEY (ABAP-PERF-37).
LOOP AT ... WHERE on a STANDARD table without a secondary key does a full scan per outer iteration; declare a SECONDARY KEY or use LOOP AT ... USING KEY (ABAP-PERF-38).
Synchronous Event Mesh send/publish (cl_em_client / cl_event_mesh); use the asynchronous dispatch API so bgRFC handles retry/dead-letter (ABAP-PERF-17).
CALL FUNCTION ... DESTINATION without bgRFC scheduling; schedule via cl_bgrfc_unit_factory for retry/persistence (ABAP-PERF-18).
cl_http_client(_factory)=>create_by_url bypasses the Destination service; use cl_http_destination_provider=>create_by_comm_arrangement (ABAP-PERF-43).
HTTP destination created by URL instead of communication arrangement; use create_by_comm_arrangement so cert/token state is shared (ABAP-PERF-44).

Deprecated classic function module call (CONVERSION_EXIT_*, NUMBER_GET_NEXT, POPUP_TO_CONFIRM, RS_COVERPAGE_*, REUSE_ALV_GRID_DISPLAY) — not S/4HANA-Cloud ready; replace with a released API/CDS/Fiori equivalent (S/4 readiness).
Access to VBFA — audit VBTYP_N/V comparisons (1-char to 4-char VBTYPL in S/4HANA); use I_BillingDocumentPredecess (S4-010).
Access to BSEG — fields renamed/extended in S/4HANA G/L; audit DMBTR/WRBTR and consider migrating reads to ACDOCA (S4-012).
Stock/quantity-shaped field with short hardcoded LENGTH — truncates under S/4 stock field-length extension; use MENG13/MENG13V (S4-015).
Season/theme/collection field hardcoded shorter than the extended FMS length; use fms_season/fms_theme/fms_collection (S4-016).
